theorems.name: Submission.ts_plane_closedBall_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (s : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → 0 ≤ s → ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ))) (closedBall (0 : Ambient n ℓ) s) = ENNReal.ofReal (omega n * s ^ n)
